prs.title: fix: propagate SSE stream errors to waiting requests
prs.author: heyhayes
prs.cluster_pick_reason: Both PRs have unknown CI and unknown test coverage, so the decision rests on approach and diff size. #2374 (2 files) is smaller than #2122 (3 files), but the two PRs address the issue differently: #2122 propagates SSE stream errors back to waiting requests so callers actually receive the exception and can unblock, while #2374 only adds logging in the default message_handler so errors become visible in logs but callers waiting on a response still receive no signal. For issue #1401 — which is a class of "errors are silently lost and callers hang" bug — logging alone is a visibility improvement, not a fix. #2122 is also older. On the criterion ordering (CI tie, tests tie, approach correctness, then diff size), #2122 wins on producing the correct behavioral outcome.
